name: Issue UCAN Token
description: Creates a venue-signed UCAN capability token for resources controlled by this venue or one of its managed custodial users. The venue is the issuer. Self-sovereign DID owners must sign UCANs with their own key using a client SDK. The token grants the audience (aud) the specified capabilities (att) until expiry (exp).

aud.description: Audience DID — who receives this capability (e.g. did:key:z6MkBob...)

att.description: Attenuations — array of {with, can} capability pairs for venue-controlled resources

output.description: Complete signed UCAN token (header, payload, sig)
